subject: Axion Labs connector: sandbox probe and reference-fit readout
messages:
From: Kevin Park <kevin@axionlabs.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Lim <rachel@axionlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Intro + sandbox ask: Axion connector specifics

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the quick sync yesterday. We ran through our end-to-end flow with Rachel and wanted to surface two things up front so Redwood can validate in the sandbox:

- We send batched payloads using a proprietary header for user-session routing (will attach a sample config).
- We perform an embeddings + rerank step where we stream candidate scores back to our service; low latency for the rerank stage is important (p95 < 250ms).

Can the Redwood sandbox simulate prefix KV caching and streaming rerank? Also if you could share the minimum network requirements and an initial compatibility checklist we can pre-seed on our side, that would speed the smoke tests.

Attaching: axion-sample-config.yaml (sample request pattern).

We can be flexible on dates — hoping to do a first smoke on Thursday or Friday this week.

Thanks,
Kevin

--
Kevin Park
Platform Integrations, Axion Labs
kevin@axionlabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0138
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Park <kevin@axionlabs.com>
Cc: Rachel Lim <rachel@axionlabs.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 12:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + sandbox ask: Axion connector specifics

Hi Kevin — great notes, and thanks for the config.

Short answer: yes — Redwood sandbox can exercise KV/prefix caching semantics and streaming responses. We'll need a couple of details to size and configure the sandbox instance correctly:

- Expected QPS and typical request size (tokens per prompt + candidates per rerank).
- Whether the rerank stage requires model-run-time scoring hooks (we support function-style callbacks but need to commune on formats).
- Will you require a pinned model family or are you OK with a model variant that prioritizes latency (smaller quantized family)?

Proposed plan:
1) We provision an isolated sandbox instance (1x A10-equivalent GPU) and pre-load your sample config.
2) Smoke test with synthetic traffic that mirrors your sample (we'll provide a test harness).
3) Run an end-to-end trial with a short Axion dataset (5–10k items).

I attached an initial compatibility matrix (redwood-compatibility-matrix.csv) and sandbox-access-instructions.pdf.

Sergio — looping you for kernel/quantization constraints and any infra caveats. Laura — can your team manage the test scheduling and share the Drive folder for artifacts?

Kevin — are you ok with Thursday 29 March, 10:00–12:00 PT for the smoke window?

Best,
Olga
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com
--
Attachments: redwood-compatibility-matrix.csv, sandbox-access-instructions.pdf
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Kevin Park <kevin@axionlabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 14:38:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Intro + sandbox ask: Axion connector specifics

Thanks — quick technical checklist from my side before we spin up the sandbox:

- Network: outbound TLS to api.redwood-inference.example:443 required; if Axion wants to hold things inbound we can provide egress IPs.
- KV/prefix caching: supported at runtime; we'll surface metrics (cache hit/miss) to the console and can export token-level traces for your team.
- Streaming rerank: supported via the streaming API; p95 target depends on payload size and batching. For your target p95 < 250ms we should: reduce batch sizes for the rerank stage and pin a low-latency model variant (we recommend a 4-bit quantized 7B variant for this workload).
- Model fallback: we'll configure an automatic fallback to a slightly larger variant if latency rises above threshold (can be disabled).

Caveats: if you need per-request custom kernels (C++ hooks) that won't be supported in the hosted sandbox. Also, we need an S3 bucket or temporary artifact share for large Axion test datasets (we can provide upload instructions).

I've attached a short runbook (internal reference) with the steps I'll execute for the smoke test.

Sergio
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
--
Attachment: redwood-smoke-runbook.md (internal)
From: Kevin Park <kevin@axionlabs.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Lim <rachel@axionlabs.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + sandbox ask: Axion connector specifics

Thanks Olga/Sergio — that all sounds reasonable. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Expected payloads: ~120 requests/second at peak, median tokens per prompt ~180, candidates per rerank ~20.
- We'll upload a 6k-item test set to the bucket; can you confirm the S3 upload endpoint and a short retention window?
- We rely on a custom header X-AXN-SESSION to correlate streams back to our service; we won't need C++ hooks — good to call that out.

Thursday 29 March 10:00–11:30 PT works for us. We'll have Rachel and a member of our infra team on the call.

Attaching: axion-sample-config.yaml (updated with batch numbers)

Regards,
Kevin
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Great — confirmed for Thu 29 Mar 10:00–11:30 PT. Logistics and next steps below:

- Sandbox provisioned: 1x A10-equivalent, low-latency model variant preloaded and pinned.
- S3 upload: please put artifacts to s3://axion-test-uploads/redwood-sandbox/; objects will be auto-cleansed after 72 hours. I'll share temporary credentials in the Drive link.
- Test plan: Sergio will execute the smoke runbook; Laura will run the orchestrated end-to-end traffic and capture traces.
- Reporting: we'll provide a short readout doc in the shared Drive with latency, failure modes, and compatibility notes.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Axion-Connector-Test-Guide
Jira: JIRA-AL-223 (for tracking tasks and follow-ups)

We're good to go — please upload the dataset and share any additional config by 8:00 PT so we have time to pre-seed the sandbox.

Thanks, and looking forward to the test.

Olga
